hoursBefore.description: Real hours between the reminder and the start of each appointment (24 = the day before at the same time).

channels.description: email always works (logged without a provider); sms needs messaging.sms.twilio, whatsapp needs messaging.whatsapp.meta.

whatsappTemplate.description: The approved WhatsApp template (utility) with four body parameters: customer name, service, date and time, business.

maxAttempts.description: Attempts per reminder for failures that may pass later (one per runner call, with backoff).
